diagnosis: Progress has stalled at a gain of only $6.7\times10^{-7}$ after 33 programs because nearly every search starts from the published configuration and, after kicking and re-annealing, returns to the same basin. The image shows that this basin is not a rigid local optimum: at the stated $10^{-9}$ contact threshold, 114 of 138 points are rattlers, no point has more than 4 contacts, and the contact graph is concentrated on only 24 points, far too sparse to lock the 7 tangent degrees of freedom of each point. At the same time, roughly the first 800 pairs all lie within about $10^{-8}$ of the maximum, creating a soft, almost-degenerate wall that makes trust-region LP steps collapse without producing exact contacts.
